Container.Name: mcp-unifi
Container.Overview: UniFi Network MCP server — exposes a UniFi Network Controller (e.g. Cloud Key Gen 2) as MCP tools over streamable-HTTP for AI agents. Native HTTP transport via UNIFI_MCP_HTTP_ENABLED, no wrapper needed. Set ExtraParams below to bind only to this server's Tailscale IP instead of all interfaces (e.g. -p 100.101.102.103:3000:3000) — replace with your own Tailscale IP. UNIFI_MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS must then include that same IP:port (the server's built-in DNS-rebinding protection rejects any other Host header with a 421).

Config.Name: UNIFI_HOST
Config.Description: UniFi controller IP (e.g. Cloud Key Gen 2)

Config.Name: UNIFI_SITE
Config.Description: Controller's internal site name (usually 'default' — NOT the display name shown in the UI)

Config.Name: UNIFI_MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS
Config.Description: Comma-separated Host headers the server will accept (DNS-rebinding protection) — must include the ip:port from your ExtraParams bind
